Border / Ring
/* Button States: Idle */ .btn { height: 52px; border-radius: 999px; transition: width 0.52s cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1), background 0.36s ease; } /* Idle */ .btn--idle { background: #B8AEE8; width: 100%; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; } /* JS: cycle states on click */ const STATES = ['idle']; let idx = 0; btn.onclick = () => { btn.className = 'btn btn--' + STATES[idx = (idx+1)%STATES.length]; };

/* Idle state */ .btn--idle { background: #B8AEE8; width: 100%; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; } /* hover */ .btn--idle.hover-scale:hover { transform: scale(1.05); }

/* Activate the "Idle" state */ function setIdle() { btn.className = 'btn btn--idle'; btn.classList.add('hover-scale'); }
